scenicChapters.title: Hautecombe → Lac d’Aiguebelette
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 31 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-hautecombe-immeuble-clarte.story: 285 km from Aix-les-Bains to Aix-les-Bains, about 4 h 55 of riding. On the way it passes Lac d’Aiguebelette, Secteur des Mongets, Immeuble Clarté and back through Secteur des Mongets. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
